ana_partner_lead: Heads-up: partner (ClearNode) asking if we can do embeddings for on-prem docs without sending raw PDFs to hosted models. They want preproc locally -> embedding call to hosted. Any operational or legal blockers?
raj_sre: technically OK. main concerns: telemetry exposure (IPs, payload sizes), egress cost. we'll need to call out retention policy.
mike_sales: pricing ask: do we bill per-vector or per-token if they pre-chunk? also asked about reserved instance/licensing for future on-prem weights.
tara_eng: Hosted embeddings billed per-vector request. Reserved/dedicated is quoted separately. For large reindexes recommend batch endpoint + backoff.
nana_partner_lead: they also want a temporary higher QPS for a 4hr reindex. possible?
raj_sre: we can grant time-limited quota bump on Hosted or recommend a scheduled reserved slot on Dedicated. infra-bot: quota_grant id=clrnode-reindex qps=1200 window=14400s by=ana_partner_lead
mike_sales: legal question: can we allow export of quantized weights later?
tara_eng: depends on model license. we'll produce a matrix: exportable=true for open OSS models, false for vendor-licensed models.
nana_partner_lead: sec questionnaire: are vectors reversible? retention? can we provide a short pasteable blurb?
raj_sre: pasteable: "Vectors are non-reversible with public methods. Default retention 30 days for telemetry/caching; deletions on request. TLS1.3 in transit; Dedicated/Private support CMK."
mike_sales: add a PII recommendation?
tara_eng: recommend partner scrub PII before sending; we can share a tiny preproc snippet.
raj_sre: egress estimate: ~0.7GB per 10k vectors. include in SOW.
nana_partner_lead: please draft SOW items: 1) temp quota 2) pricing line 3) licensing matrix 4) security blurb 5) telemetry export options. Thanks!
